capabilities: Suggest internal [[]] links while typing note names in plain text
Index only user-specified target folders instead of the whole vault
Match note names by prefix or fuzzy substring
Generate links via Obsidian's generateMarkdownLink API, respecting path-format preferences
Optionally block navigation when clicking links to indexed files (click guard)
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English); the author promotes tutorials on Xiaohongshu and a QQ support group; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Designed for a deep Chinese input experience in Obsidian, where single-character CJK triggers matter.
problem: Obsidian's link suggestions only appear inside [[ ]] brackets, so typing a note name in plain text offers no way to turn it into a link.
summary: Autocomplete plugin that suggests internal [[]] links as you type note names from chosen folders, with prefix and fuzzy matching and CJK-aware triggering.
